GOVERNMENT OF THE DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA
OFFICE OF THE CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER
OFFICE OF TAX AND REVENUE
March 7, 2025
OTR TAX NOTICE 2025-01
NOTICE REGARDING ELECTRONIC FILING REQUIREMENTS FOR CERTAIN
TAXPAYERS
Taxpayers Over Certain Income Thresholds to Submit Copy of Federal Income Tax Return
with the Filing of D.C. Returns
This notice advises taxpayers of a new filing requirement for the 2026 filing season recently
published in a final regulation on January 31, 2025, in the District of Columbia Register on page
912 of Volume 72.1 The regulation requires taxpayers exceeding certain income thresholds to
submit an electronic copy of their federal income tax return with the filing of their District of
Columbia (“District”) tax returns. This requirement applies for D.C. tax returns for taxable years
beginning after December 31, 2024 filed in the 2026 filing season. This requirement does not
apply for the current 2025 filing season.
The following persons will be required to submit an electronic copy of their federal income tax
return, including any schedules or other information provided to the Internal Revenue Service,
for the corresponding tax year or period:
(a) Individuals who are single or married filing separately with gross income exceeding
$500,000 for the taxable year, or who are married filing jointly, registered domestic
partner filing jointly, married filing separately on a combined return or registered
domestic partners filing separately on a combined return with gross income
exceeding $1,000,000;
(b) Corporations with gross income for the taxable year exceeding $2,500,000
worldwide, and $50,000 apportioned to the District;
(c) Unincorporated businesses with gross income for the taxable year exceeding
$2,500,000 worldwide, and $50,000 apportioned to the District;
(d) Partnerships with gross income for the taxable year exceeding $2,500,000
worldwide, and $50,000 apportioned to the District;
(e) Fiduciaries of an estate or trust with gross income for the taxable year exceeding
$1,000,000; or

(f) Corporations who are members of an affiliated group with gross income for the
taxable year exceeding $2,500,000 worldwide, and $50,000 apportioned to the
District.
If you have any questions, please contact Customer Service Administration at 202-727-
4829.
